reviewFindings: Regenerated from a new side-view master after owner rejected the previous calf raise. Short forefoot step, hanging heels, near-vertical legs, horizontal hip hinge and articulated lower-back cushion make the movement explicit.

Selected sequence uses lowered heels, neutral ankles, raised heels, then return. The first exaggerated top generation was rejected; a restrained neutral pose became the intermediate before deriving the final raised pose.

One rigid lever-and-plate source rotates around the fixed rear pivot; the cushion follows its endpoint. Fixed lower machine regions reuse master pixels. No body warping or resizing is applied by the builder.

Small generated hand/forefoot silhouette changes and anatomical consistency still need review before production release. Fixed machine pixels and rigid lever construction do not automatically approve human technique.
